items.title: Open subspaces of the reduction of a thickening lift uniquely to the total space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For a thickening X subset X' of algebraic spaces over S, every open subspace U of X is the base change of a unique open subspace U' of X'. The retained proof constructs U' as the object of the big etale site of X' corresponding to U under the topological invariance equivalence, observes that the resulting U' -> X' is etale and universally injective, and concludes it is an open immersion by the etale-plus-universally-injective characterization in Morphisms of Spaces. Retained author proof at lines 1656-1663.
